title: Density expectation and uniform inner product
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a nonnegative function on the Boolean cube $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ whose uniform expectation is $1$, and let $g:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of $g$ with respect to the density $\varphi$ equals the uniform inner product of $\varphi$ and $g$.
